newsitem.title: USA: Glenayre Technologies sued by shareholders.
newsitem.headline: Glenayre Technologies sued by shareholders.

text.p: Glenayre Technologies Inc shareholders Wednesday filed a class action lawsuit against the company, alleging it and some executives concealed facts about Glenayre's financial condition, plaintiff lawyers said.

The suit, filed on behalf of Glenayre shareholders between February 6 and September 13, alleges the company concealed material facts about its financial statements -- including problems with its orders and backlogs -- and that some of its officers sold more than $58 million of stock without disclosing the information.
Glenayre officials were not available to comment.
